{{Quote|He worked off-and-on for ''Jabba the Hut!'' There's an old ''grudge'' involved!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="TS" />}}
An '''unidentified simian bounty hunter''' recognized [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] when he entered [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on a mission for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Believing that [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] would pay him well for Luke Skywalker's death, he attempted to vaporize the rebel. [[Anduvil]] shot the bounty hunter's hand, causing the intended kill shot to miss and saving Luke Skywalker. Luke Skywalker was able to identify him as an occasional employee of Jabba Desilijic Tiure.<ref name="TS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Both the bounty hunter and Luke Skywalker refer to the bounty hunter's employer as "Jabba the Hut" with a single "t." This spelling was common until the release of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars:'' Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].
